payload.subject: n8n automation for appointment reminders - can we talk this week?
payload.body: Hi, I manage operations for a three-location physiotherapy practice. We want SMS and email appointment reminders plus a no-show follow-up built in n8n, connected to our booking system's API. Budget is around USD 3,000 and we would like to start next week. Are you free for a 20-minute call on Thursday or Friday?
